label: In code (Python, JavaScript, Java, Go and similar), a command to run written as separate quoted items, the program name and its arguments: a list passed to subprocess.run/Popen/call/check_output (written with the subprocess. prefix), the argument array of Node's spawn, the arguments of Java's ProcessBuilder or Go's exec.Command, or a list stored in a variable named cmd, command or argv; it lights on the opening bracket or the comma after the first item. Ordinary lists (fruit, numbers, column names, even a list of program names that is never run) stay quiet, and so does a whole command written as one string (os.system('ls -la'), cmd = 'git status') or described in prose.
